invention.ref: The Northern Song government establishes a jiaozi office in Sichuan and issues official jiaozi paper money (1023–1024)
invention.ref_zh: 北宋在四川官办交子务并发行官方交子（1023–1024）

mass_production.ref: Yuan dynasty expands state paper currency (chao) empire-wide

popularization.ref: The Ming dynasty issued the famous Da Ming Baochao notes

locations.place_label_zh: 中国四川成都（交子发源地）

sources.title: The Rise and Demise of Paper Money in Imperial China — Hoover Institution

notes: 四川民间私交子约在十世纪末已出现；本条目以1023–1024年官府接管并发行为主年份。
notes_en: Private jiaozi notes circulated in Sichuan by the late 10th century; this entry uses the 1023–1024 state takeover and official issue as the primary mark.
summary_zh: 世界最早的纸币出现在中国：北宋四川交子在1023–1024年由官府发行，其后元明继续推行钞法。
summary_en: The world’s earliest banknotes appeared in China: Northern Song Sichuan jiaozi were officially issued in 1023–1024, with Yuan and Ming states later expanding paper currency.
summary_ja: 世界最古の紙幣は中国に現れた。北宋の四川では1023–1024年に交子が官府によって発行され、後に元と明も紙幣の流通を広げた。
